proper_3cnf_counterexample.oracle_machine: query SAT(F); accept UNSAT iff answer is NO
proper_3cnf_counterexample.forged_transcript: claim NO on the SAT formula

interpretation: Checking witnesses only for claimed SAT answers is sound exactly for upward-monotone acceptance predicates in the fixed nonadaptive model. The canonical one-query UNSAT predicate is antimonotone, so an unproved claimed-NO answer makes the transcript verifier unsound.
